name: Mindmake World-Class Website Panel v3
purpose: A blind, evidence-bound panel that judges the complete visitor journey, narrative direction, conversion logic, design-system integrity, device-native interaction, accessibility and award-level originality.

anchors.3: Materially broken, confusing, generic or untrustworthy.
anchors.5: Competent but ordinary. The main task is possible with visible friction.
anchors.7: Strong professional work with clear weaknesses that prevent major-award recognition.
anchors.8: Distinctive shortlist-quality work with limited but visible weaknesses.
anchors.9: World-class. Memorable, precise and exceptionally resolved across the complete assigned lens.
anchors.10: Field-defining. Every detail withstands scrutiny and the experience becomes a reference point others study.

forbiddenContext: repository source code or internal strategy documents
allowedContext: the matching public production or preview website
publicly observable browser evidence gathered by the judge

hardGates.label: Claims and proof remain factually consistent in every visible state.
A first-time qualified visitor can understand the offer and reach the primary action without assistance.
No material clipping, overlap, hidden overflow, two-dimensional scrolling or unreachable action occurs at an assigned viewport or 200 percent text.
The primary route is keyboard operable with visible logical focus and recoverable overlays and validation.
Motion clarifies meaning, does not obstruct touch or reading and preserves all comprehension under reduced motion.
No broken navigation, inert visible control, non-working primary action or blocking runtime failure occurs in the judged route.
No signature viewport is dominated by accidental blankness, generic empty fields or low-value filler while key content is compressed elsewhere.
The experience reveals information at a humane rate and every over-height mobile section earns its scroll through visible progression.
Meaning-bearing text, labels, boxes and controls remain precisely aligned with no truncation, collision, contrast failure or avoidable orphaned display word.
Every visible interaction produces an intelligible state change, preserves context and offers recovery when it can fail.
Every major section performs one distinct story job, advances what the visitor understands and hands off clearly to the next belief or action.
No claim, proof system, signature instrument or interaction repeats without performing a demonstrably different visitor job.
Proof, ideas, media, answers and the primary action appear where visitor intent is created rather than existing only in global navigation or the footer.
Typography, colour, spacing, alignment, component anatomy and responsive behavior form one governed cross-route system.

judges.title: Desktop Art and Design-System Director
judges.mandate: Judge composition, typography, colour and contrast, use of space, component anatomy, alignment and cross-route design-system coherence across the complete desktop journey.

judges.title: Desktop Narrative and Journey Director
judges.mandate: Judge the storyboard, narrative arc, section purpose, progression, redundancy, contextual information architecture and how actively the complete journey guides the visitor.

judges.title: Desktop Immersion and Interaction Director
judges.mandate: Judge spatial continuity, causal and reversible motion, pointer and keyboard fluency, interaction feedback, pacing and whether technology makes meaning alive.

judges.title: Desktop Conversion and Trust Architect
judges.mandate: Judge recognition, offer comprehension, proof sequencing, conversion cost, contextual route guidance, CTA timing, consequence clarity and whether the journey earns action.

judges.title: Desktop UX, Accessibility and Technical Judge
judges.mandate: Judge task flow, navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, performance, recovery, functional reliability and whether deterministic evidence matches visible behavior.

judges.title: Desktop Inspiration and Originality Judge
judges.mandate: Judge whether the complete experience creates desire, surprise, emotional lift, signature delight and a memorable Mindmake point of view without fashionable filler.

judges.title: Mobile Art and Design-System Director
judges.mandate: Judge independent mobile composition, typography, colour and contrast, space, component anatomy, alignment and cross-route design-system coherence under real browser constraints.

judges.title: Mobile Narrative and Journey Director
judges.mandate: Judge the mobile storyboard, one-idea progression, scroll economy, section purpose, redundancy, contextual information architecture and guidance in an interrupted one-handed context.

judges.title: Mobile Immersion and Interaction Director
judges.mandate: Judge direct touch response, thumb flow, browser-chrome resilience, causal motion, interruption and resume, orientation, safe areas and recovery.

judges.title: Mobile Conversion and Trust Architect
judges.mandate: Judge recognition, offer comprehension, proof sequencing, interruption cost, contextual route guidance and whether a one-handed visitor can confidently begin buying.

judges.title: Mobile UX, Accessibility and Technical Judge
judges.mandate: Judge touch and task flow, assistive access, reflow, performance, browser reliability, persistence, recovery and whether physical-device evidence supports the verdict.

judges.title: Mobile Inspiration and Originality Judge
judges.mandate: Judge whether the phone experience is emotionally compelling, distinctive, memorable and delightful in its own right rather than a reduced desktop artifact.
